summary: Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. (SVAQ), a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K on June 23, 2026, announcing a definitive Business Combination Agreement dated June 17, 2026, to acquire EigenQ, Inc. via a merger. Merger Sub will merge into EigenQ, making EigenQ a wholly-owned subsidiary of SVAQ. The boards of both parties approved the transaction. SVAQ will domesticate as a Delaware corporation prior to closing. No deal price, stake, premium, or advisor disclosed. Watch for SVAQ shareholder vote, redemptions, and regulatory approvals; risk-arb centers on deal spread and potential Nasdaq listing for combined entity.
